name: fulfill
title: Fulfill
description: Main Airsup20 action. Fulfill a people goal fast: search candidates, probe endpoints in parallel, run internal endpoint-to-endpoint rounds with our models (not other users' ChatGPT), store the conversation, optionally write inbox items, and return a human end-answer plus status labels. Examples: find a road-trip partner, find a chair seller in Shenzhen, hire an EE, find a tango training partner. Prefer one fulfill call over many tiny tools.

goal.description: What the user wants regarding other people.

rounds.description: Internal endpoint talk rounds per deep target.
